findings.reason: the one node dispatched now would either stall on a grouping that does not exist yet or ship a report over the very grouping the plan exists to replace, and its followup warns about the lint only, not the grouping.
findings.text: §2's report is specified per pattern family with lint findings by class, but §2 declares no depends-on; pattern families come from sn-catalog-grouping §2 and the lint from sn-house-style §4, both still `implementable`, and §3 declares the same two dependencies. As dispatched, §2 would run its report over the existing HAS_PARENT grouping that §1 names as the wrong family.

findings.reason: §4 exists to decide whether making entries agree made any of them worse and to set the WEST cost limit, so a threshold that can pass while measuring nothing calibrates the WEST run on an unproven instrument.
findings.text: §4's done-when asserts "No member's documentation score falls below the acceptance threshold" with no negative control; nothing shows a fall below that threshold is detectable, so a uniform after-column of unchanged scores passes whether the instrument works or not.

findings.reason: a function whose only caller §2 removes, reused by §3 without a named caller, can leave the snapshot-before-reset unreached so `sn harmonize --apply` resets documentation with no way back, the exact loss §3 claims the snapshot prevents.
findings.text: §2 deletes `sn run --families`, whose handler at imas_codex/cli/sn.py:2745 is the only production caller of mark_families_for_regen (harmonize.py:728); §3 relies on that function for the pre-reset snapshot ("as mark_families_for_regen already does") but names no caller in the new command.

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — the harmonize.py docstring pointer, select_anchor (harmonize.py:103), mark_families_for_regen (harmonize.py:728), the two flags named for deletion (sn.py:1775, sn.py:6102), the census href (resolved as `.html`) and all three depends-on targets (sn-house-style#s4, sn-house-style#s5, sn-catalog-grouping#s2) resolve.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — §4's done-when rests on a threshold assertion ("No member's documentation score falls below the acceptance threshold") with no declared negative control, so it cannot show a sub-threshold score is detectable.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §4 records its figures "in the plan's evidence", the repository's own convention for plan evidence (cf. docs/plans/sn-west-review-rehearsal.html), which is git-tracked and served by the docs surface rather than a session scratchpad.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the command name `harmonize` matches the existing module and reuses the word the prompts already use, and no plan label, ticket or version tag reaches a symbol or file.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §2 deletes the only production caller of mark_families_for_regen, and §3 relies on that function for snapshot-before-reset without naming the caller that will reach it.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §2 is one deliverable (one surface replacing three routes, flags deleted in the same change) and §3 and §4 each name one.
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — §2 declares no depends-on at all (the plan-section-depends-on meta names only s3 and s4), though its report is specified "for each pattern family in scope" with "lint findings by class", which sn-catalog-grouping §2 and sn-house-style §4 provide and which §3 does declare.
